newsitem.title: USA: Soros group completes Phoenix investment.
newsitem.headline: Soros group completes Phoenix investment.

text.p: Phoenix Information Systems Corp said Monday that a Soros investment group has bought 833,333 shares of its Series C Convertible Preferred Stock for $15 million.
Affiliates of George Soros, Purnendu Chatterjee and Quantum Industrial Holdings Ltd make up S-C Phoenix Partners, one of Phoenix's major shareholders.

Phoenix said it will use $7.5 million of the proceeds to buy an interest in American Aviation Ltd, whose principal asset is a 25 percent interest in China Hainan Airlines. The company said it will use the balance to expand its new joint venture with China Southern Airlines.
The information systems company focuses on technologies for automation in the travel and tourism industry.
